master_full_text: 1. Payment. Customer shall pay all undisputed invoices within Net 30 days. 2. Liability. Supplier's aggregate liability is capped at fees paid in the prior twelve months. 3. Confidentiality. Confidential Information includes business, technical, and pricing information disclosed by either party. 4. Termination. Either party may terminate for convenience with 30 days' written notice. 5. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by New York law.
